_comment: Pinned helper binaries bundled into the distributable build.
Nothing binary is committed to this repository; fetch_binaries.py downloads
these at build time and verifies each archive against the sha256 below.
These URLs are also the written offer of source required by the GPL: mpv is
GPLv2+ and the ffmpeg builds are GPLv3. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.
url      exact download; the digest below belongs to this file
sha256   null means 'not yet pinned' - CI refuses it for releases
release  {repo, asset} - used to find a replacement when the pinned url
has gone away (nightly builders prune old releases) and by
rolling  true when the url is a moving tag ('latest'): a digest mismatch
is reported and the new digest recorded in the build manifest
extract  glob patterns of files to copy into vendor/<platform>/
Whatever actually gets bundled is written to vendor/<platform>/MANIFEST.json
with its digest, and that file ships inside the application.

mpv._note: Static build: mpv.exe carries every codec and needs no DLLs.
Relocatable AppDir (glibc-free 'anylinux' build, works on SteamOS). The yt-dlp downloader and self-updater hooks are removed so mpv never touches the network on launch.
